$comment: Text pool for the Global Outreach prayer category.
requests: Safety for our short-term team heading to Guatemala.
Our church's medical team leaves for Honduras next week. Pray for the doctors and nurses, for good health for the whole team, and that every patient they see would feel the love of Jesus.
Praying for the clean water project our partners in Kenya are finishing this spring. A working well will change daily life for hundreds of families in that village.
Lifting up the missionary family our church supports in Thailand. Their kids are starting at a new school and having a hard time making friends. Pray for the kids especially.
For the new church plant our partners are starting in Peru. A small group of believers is meeting in a home. Pray for open hearts in the neighborhood and for strong local leaders.
My daughter is going on her first mission trip with the student team this summer. She is excited and a little nervous. Pray for safe travel and that she comes home changed.
Our mission partners in Haiti are running a week of kids camps. Pray for energy for the volunteers and for the children to hear about Jesus in a way they understand.
Please pray for the health of one of our missionaries who has been sick for several weeks overseas. The local doctors are doing their best, and the family needs rest and good care.
Open hearts in the villages our team visits.
Remember the families on our Mexico build team. They are building two homes in five days and the work is hard in the heat. Pray for strong bodies and good teamwork.

For the pastors our church is helping to train in Uganda. Many of them walk or ride for hours to attend the classes and then go back and teach their own congregations. Most serve without pay and have families to feed. Pray that God would multiply what they are learning, provide for their needs, and protect them on the long roads home.

Our missionaries in the Philippines are in a season of deep transition. Their oldest is leaving for college back in America, their ministry is growing faster than they can keep up with, and they are feeling stretched thin. They asked the church to pray for wisdom, for rest, and for more local workers to share the load. Thank you for carrying them with us.
details: We send them out from Phoenix, but they need our prayers every single day they are gone.
Everyone involved has worked hard to prepare, and we trust God with every part of this.
Our partners there say they can feel the prayers of this church, and they are so thankful.
Pray also for the families back home while their loved ones are away serving.
Communication can be spotty, so we may not get updates for a while.
Pray that the work would honor the local believers and keep pointing people to Jesus long after we are gone.
answers: Thank you for praying! We heard that God's hand has been on every part of the work.
Great news from our partners. Doors are opening and hearts are open. Keep praying!
Some things have been harder than expected, but God has been faithful through it all. Thank you.
We received an encouraging update this week. Grateful for every prayer.
Still waiting to hear more, but we trust God is at work. Please keep them in your prayers.
